result:
I’d remove the ease of dehumanization.

Not by forcing everyone to agree, or by erasing conflict, but by making it impossible to treat another person as less than real. No lies that turn people into symbols, enemies, vermin, obstacles, statistics. If every act of cruelty carried the full, immediate weight of the person receiving it, the world would change faster than any law or ideology could.
